details.title: Frontend Developer
details.description:
Why choose CoodyAt Coody, we cut out everything unnecessary to give more back to you as a consultant. And we have done it in the package of a lean and efficient organization, meaning no overpaid managers, no fancy offices and no extravagant conferences. Instead we give you:

Maximized Compensation. Typically a +40% salary increase.

Freedom & Flexibility. No bosses. All digital. Fully remote for those who prefer.

Employment Security. High salary, pension, insurance, paid vacation and a big educational fund.

Shape the Future. Projects and assignments for digital game changers like Spotify, Hemnet, Visa, Tobii, Toca Boca, Mojang, Flightradar24, SJ, and exciting startups and scaleups.

As we are growing, we are continuously hiring senior tech consultants and connecting them with impactful projects through our client network.

What you’ll be doingAs a Senior Front-end Developer at Coody, you’ll help build and scale new and existing products with real end-to-end ownership of the service, the code, and the outcomes. Assignments are typically 6-24 months, and as a consultant you’re expected to ramp up quickly and deliver value from day one. While your home base is frontend using JavaScript and TypeScript, you’ll sometimes work across the full tech stack (e.g., integrations, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD) to ship complete solutions. You’ll design and build scalable, robust frontend applications, contribute to architecture and testing/automation, and play an active role in a teams of different sizes.

Who you areWe are seeking a Frontend Engineer with at least 8+ years of experience. You must have a proven ability to get things done. Here’s what we’re seeking:


At least 8+ years of experience using TypeScript and Javascript.
Solid skills in modern libraries and frameworks such as Next.js, React, Vue.js, Svelte, Node, NestJS, Angular, Express.js, Solid, React Native.
A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Based in Sweden: You must have Swedish citizenship, a valid work visa, temporary or permanent residency.
Fluent in English (spoken and written).
Ability to start immidiately.


This is CoodyWe’re one of Sweden’s fastest-growing tech consultancies, expanding in both people and revenue. We attribute our growth to our simple yet powerful approach to Gravity-Free Consulting, combining the freedom and flexibility of freelancing with the security of traditional employment.

At Coody, we believe in freedom, trust, and ambition, which means you’ll feel like a freelancer with free rein on assignments that excite you, while enjoying the benefits of being employed by a company that invests in your growth.

Our senior sales team has built a vast, carefully curated client network, enabling our consultants to work with some of the most innovative companies in Sweden, Finland, the US, and the UK across Gaming, Fintech, Medtech, AI, SaaS, Aviation, and Automotive, tackling real technical challenges while shaping their own career paths.

We’re a diverse community of ambitious tech professionals, representing more than 14 nationalities.

Coody is more of a platform than a traditional consultancy. Everything we do is designed to help you work and live according to your own priorities and ambitions. If you’re curious to see how this works in practice, explore our Employee Handbook and discover a company that truly puts consultants first.

How to applyAre you excited to take your career to the next level and meet the criterias? Apply now, and we'll be in touch shortly.

details.title: Web Engineer (HTML / CSS / JavaScript)
details.description:
At Crytek we're building a scalable UI platform powered by a Design System implemented in Coherent Gameface (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

Instead of building UI screen-by-screen, we are creating reusable components and architecture that power Hunt: Showdown and future Crytek titles.

We’re looking for a Web Engineer to help build this system - translating Figma components into production-ready UI and shaping how UI is developed across Crytek.

This is an opportunity to build the UI foundation for multiple games, not just individual screens.

We welcome candidates from a variety of backgrounds and experiences who are excited about building thoughtful, scalable UI.

This position is based in Frankfurt, Germany.

What you'll Do


Build reusable UI components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Implement scalable UI architecture using Coherent Gameface
Translate Figma design system components into production-ready UI
Assemble UI screens from reusable components
Improve the design to development pipeline, including tooling and workflows
Collaborate with UX, UI art, and engineering to deliver a modern UI pipeline
Help define and scale the UI platform used across future Crytek projects


What you bring


Experience in web or UI engineering (rough guideline: ~3+ years, but we value equivalent practical experience)
Strong skills in HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript
Experience building component-based UI systems
Good understanding of UI architecture and performance
Experience collaborating closely with design teams
Willingness to relocate to Frankfurt am Main, Germany.


Nice to have (not required)


Experience with games, Figma, or AI-assisted workflows
Experience with Web Components and a major frontend framework (React, Vue, Svelte etc.)


What You Can Expect From Us

Career Path

Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives.

Relocation Support

We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family.

You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).

Company Apartment

To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.

Public Transport Pass

Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.

Gym Card

A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.

State-of-the-art Office

We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.

German Classes

Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family.

Events

Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!

Vacation Days

At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

details.title: Senior React Developer (m/f/d)
details.description:
🚀 We're hiring across Europe: Senior Front-End Developer (React/TypeScript)

📍 Vienna (on-site)

🛂 Visa sponsorship available

✅ Full-time

At Novasign, we're redefining the future of bioprocessing. Our platform, Novasign Studio, combines intelligent hybrid models, automation, and modern microservices (SOA) architecture to accelerate the development of life-saving therapies, next-generation enzymes, and sustainable food technologies.

We're scaling fast with a growing customer base across biotech and life sciences. If you're looking to make a real-world impact with cutting-edge machine learning and SaaS technology, we want to hear from you. We're hiring ten new team members in the next four months, and this role is critical in driving our growth.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Front-End Developer with deep React (Next.js) expertise to help us build modern, user-friendly, and performant interfaces. In this role, you will design and implement real-time, data-rich applications, collaborating closely with our software engineering and consulting teams. While your primary focus will be front-end development.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain modern React/TypeScript (Next.js)
Collaborate with back-end engineers
Apply best practices
Work in Agile/Scrum teams, participate in code reviews, and contribute to architectural documentation
Ensure high-quality, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on user experience


Requirements


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
Strong Experience with React and TypeScript + Next.js
Expertise in data fetching and caching with React Query (or similar)
Proficiency in state management, UI component libraries, and modern build tools
Hands-on experience with testing frameworks
Solid knowledge of CSS frameworks (Material UI or similar)
Experienced in Agile/Scrum workflows with excellent English communication skills


Bonus / Optional Skills


Understanding of real-time applications (SignalR, WebSockets)
Proficiency in data visualization libraries (ECharts, Plotly, HighCharts)
Familiarity with Storybook for component-driven development
Familiarity with C# and Python


Benefits


Innovation Culture: We are an international team. We value new ideas, open discussions, and constructive criticism. Your voice shapes our technological direction
Professional Growth: Continuous learning opportunities and career development in cutting-edge software
Meaningful Impact: Work on software that accelerates life-saving therapies, enzyme manufacturing and sustainable food production
Competitive Package: We offer an attractive salary above industry standards, complemented by comprehensive benefits, including a free food allowance. In accordance with the IT collective agreement (minimum ST1 - Regelstufe), the minimum gross annual salary is €53,802; however, your actual compensation will reflect your skills, experience, and impact and will be significantly higher
Full time (38,5 h/week) - 25 days of paid holidays per full calendar year

details.title: Frontend Engineer
details.description:
About You

You are a natural problem solver looking to broaden your frontend skills by working on interesting real-world projects. Does this sound like you? Read further.

As one of the fastest-growing design and development agencies in the region, we specialize in creating cutting-edge solutions in AI, fintech, web3, healthcare, and edutech for our international clients. If you're seeking a place to maximize your potential in record time, 2025 is your year to shine with us!

What Are We Looking For


Minimum 2 years of work experience in frontend development
Excellent knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript
Thorough understanding of React.js and its core principles
Next.js experience (not mandatory, but it is a big plus)
Angular experience (not mandatory, but it is a plus)
Experience with tools like Webpack, SystemJS, Grunt, etc.
Excellent grasp of Git
Familiarity with RESTful APIs
Familiarity with ES6 specifications
Knowledge of authorization mechanisms, such as JSON Web Token
Experience working with different deployment platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, Heroku, VPS)
Strong analytical skills and problem-solving attitude
Keen attention to detail
Excellent written and spoken English
Eligibility to work in Croatia


What Will You Do


Implement astonishing frontend solutions
Implement custom solutions and use 3rd party APIs and solutions.
Propose and execute technical solutions to different challenges
Solve real-world problems
Work together on projects with mobile developers, designers, and project managers
Work on projects from different industries


What Can You Expect


Freedom and opportunity to build things from scratch instead of plugging into legacy systems
Competitive salary based on your experience and the value you bring to the team
Flexible working hours and a hybrid or remote work policy
Extra vacation days after the first year of employment
A pet-friendly office
Paid transportation and meal allowance
Fully subsidized gym membership (MultiSport card)


Our values


Honesty - Honesty is a great source of power and an engine of simplicity. We value it before anything else.
Clients second - We have a mindset of putting our employees first and clients second. We take the best care of our employees and only then they can take the best care of our clients.
Doing the right thing - Integrity is the foundation of our team. We commit to doing the right thing — even when no one is watching.
Owning our mistakes - We grow by owning our mistakes and learning from them. We reflect, analyze and share our mistakes using the opportunity to improve on a personal and organizational level.


Like what you see? Don’t be shy, apply!

Please Note

Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Only candidates who are already authorized to work in Croatia will be considered at this time.

details.title: Frontend Developer
details.description:
Mayflower is a technology company that alters the entertainment industry to a new level of perception and engagement.

We are building the future of live entertainment. We believe that by providing people with the best and high-quality live streaming experience in entertainment, we can tackle the world’s “problems” better, together!

We’re hiring Senior Frontend developer into two teams: the Product team, focused on building new features and improving user experience, and the Technical team, responsible for system architecture, performance, scalability, and fault tolerance. You’ll join one of these teams depending on your strengths and interests.

Job Responsibilities


Design and implement new functionality for the website and core applications, including performance optimization and enhancement of existing features.
Continuously improve code quality by refactoring legacy code, resolving performance bottlenecks, and aligning the codebase with modern standards and best practices.
Participate in the design and implementation of scalable and efficient architectural solutions, including modularization of the codebase and development of fault-tolerant systems for high-load environments.
Write and maintain unit and integration tests, support ongoing maintenance of existing features, and ensure stability across deployments.
Identify and resolve security vulnerabilities; support the integration and migration to new API interfaces.
Research and evaluate new technologies for possible integration; maintain and update shared libraries to align with evolving technical standards.
5+ years of experience and knowledge of JavaScript: React.js, Vanila JS, Event Loop, Scope, Context, Prototype, Server-side render, Isomorphic Application;
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS, Post & Pre Processing CSS;
Experience in creating Single Page Applications on React/Preact/Hyperapp and TypeScript;
Understanding of the principles and operation of AJAX, WebSockets, CORS security policies;
Experience with Redux, ES2020, Node.js, Sass;
Understanding of modular development principles, Micro Frontends;
Skills and experience in unit testing of functionality and business logic;
Skills and experience in profiling, debugging, and optimization (client/server side);
Experience with application build systems webpack, rollup, including esbuild, babel;
Technical English (tasks and documentation are in English).


Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:


EU-based employment contract and a 3-year Cyprus work visa with full support for your relocation and visa processes, including assistance for your family.
Full relocation package: flights to Limassol for you and your family, a company-covered apartment for the first month, and full relocation support to make your move smooth and hassle-free.
Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.
Private medical insurance for you and your family, a corporate mobile plan (unlimited in Cyprus with roaming included), and interest-free support for car purchases.
Mindfulness & well-being support, including psychological assistance with 50% coverage.
50% coverage of school and kindergarten fees for your children.
Fully covered sports benefits, and also access to in-house electric scooters and bike rentals, and cycling purchase compensation.
Investment in your growth: paid language courses and access to suited-for-you development programs, including conferences, training programs, and coaching to support your professional journey.
A culture of recognition: a peer reward program to celebrate your contributions.
A fully equipped office in Limassol’s city center, with everything you need for deep work and collaboration.
Free catering in the office and an in-house coffee bar with high-quality drinks and a health bar stocked with nutritious snacks.
A strong engineering culture: international teams, corporate events, team buildings, and hackathons—because great work happens in great communities.


Recruitment process


HR interview (40 min);
Technical interview (1,5 hour);
Live-coding (1,5 hour)
Final interview with the team.
